label: seen in text
finding: Decay is engineered dependence, not ordinary mechanical wear.
detail: Sabine explains planned obsolescence, corporate-exclusive stabilizer and biosynthetic immune passcodes. Medicine is bodily support and a means of corporate control. This is the character account; executable biomedical simulation is not established.

label: seen in text
finding: Food remains necessary for this artificial body.
detail: The shipped guide says condition falls one segment per cycle, can be hurt by violence/injury/lack of food, and energy falls two segments per cycle. Starvation converts energy loss into condition loss and doubles per-cycle condition depletion. Do not derive an exact combined formula from this prose.

label: seen in text
finding: Condition limits the next cycle's action capacity.
detail: The guide links worse condition to fewer newly rolled dice. Dice are allocated to actions; resting at home ends the cycle and replenishes them. Exact condition-to-count thresholds were not decoded.

label: seen in text
finding: A selected die and the appropriate skill define the action attempt.
detail: The guide names Engineer, Interface, Endure, Intuit and Engage; modifiers -1, 0, +1, +2 alter the slotted die, and some actions require +1. Positive, neutral and negative outcomes can change clocks, items, energy or condition. Full odds lookup and clamps remain opaque.

label: seen in text
finding: Data-cloud actions give low or specific dice a different use.
detail: The shipped tutorial requires matching a displayed die to unlock extraction; Interface +1/+2 offers more possible matches. This is a distinct selection rule, not merely a bigger general success percentage.

label: seen in text
finding: Action clocks and cycle clocks advance for different reasons.
detail: Guide text puts action-filled clocks below contributing actions; cycle clocks tick once per cycle without player input and appear on location icons. Completing a clock signals an imminent good or bad event. Dragos' debt is the guide's example of pressure independent of project work.

label: seen in text
finding: Breaking down continues the life with an impairment.
